abstract.p: The AraNLP system is designed for the MAHED Shared Task 2025 on text-based hate and hope classification in Arabic. The challenge was divided into three subtasks: (1) Text-based Hate and Hope Speech Classification, (2) Emotion, Offensive, and Directed Hate Detection (Multitask), and (3) Multimodal Hateful Meme Detection. The AraNLP system based on the AraBERT model achieved Macro F1-score 65% for Sub-task 1 and the results are published in the leaderboard, with rank 20. After submitting the results, the proposed model was updated to improve its performance and achieved Macro F1-score 70%, this makes the AraNLP system nearly equivalent to rank 4 in the leaderboard.
